observations.title: How deformable_body.py distinguishes soft bodies: per-body UIPC geometry building with SoftBodyRange/ClothRange applied to both UIPC solvers.
Per-body UIPC solver tracking using SoftBodyRange/ClothRange implemented, then deformable_body.py simplified by removing BFS tet grouping.
test_uipc_cloth 5/5 passed; test_uipc_deformable 0/3 failed with NameError in _build_tet_groups.
NameError in _build_tet_groups fixed by adding model = self._model.
cloth.py type safety fixes: set() to int comprehension, pyright ignores for dynamic attrs.
test_uipc_deformable 3/3 green after model scope fix.
Per-body UIPC solver tracking: SoftBodyRange/ClothRange implemented; BFS tet grouping removed from DeformableBodyBuilder because authored ranges made it redundant.
Implemented per-body index tracking for UIPC solvers and refactored deformable_body.py + cloth.py to use exact authored ranges instead of particle heuristics.
SoftBodyRange/ClothRange implementation and deformable_body.py refactor to exact authored ranges, then simplified to remove BFS grouping.
deformable_body.py fully reworked: connected-component grouping, fixed-vertex marking, mesh_partition.
mesh_partition(sc, 16) added to cloth UIPC geometry building.
Added tests: single SoftBodyRange with disconnected tets + explicit fallback path.
test_uipc_deformable reverted to 3 tests; new tests not persisted.
Per-body UIPC solver tracking: SoftBodyRange/ClothRange implementation and DeformableBodyBuilder simplified to one-range-one-geometry, no BFS grouping.
test_uipc_deformable expanded to 5 tests, all passing.
DeformableBodyBuilder: _build_tet_groups renamed to _build_tet_set.

Query: does example_uipc_cloth_franka.py have fixed cloth vertices?
Query: does example_cloth_franka.py have fixed vertices for cloth mesh?
Test added: UIPC cloth-franka must use robot contact, not soft handle API.
example_uipc_cloth_franka.py refactored: soft-handle API removed, robot contact activated.
example_uipc_cloth_franka.py used soft-handle API; TDD red phase confirmed.
TDD cycle complete: test green, quat_to_vec4 helper removed.
UIPC init failed: Franka geometry intersected cloth and body_0 at t=0.
Reverted Franka base position and cloth spawn height to fix UIPC init intersection.
UIPC workspace caches old sanity-check logs; example runs with original Franka base.
Final confirmed git diff: example_uipc_cloth_franka.py and test_examples.py.
Only uv available; ruff/black/mypy/pylint not installed in this environment.
Keyframe sequence totals 70.5s = 4230 frames; num_frames=3850 ends simulation early.
Franka FR3 body structure: 9 links, fr3_link7 at index 6 in URDF-only builder.
num_frames constant extracted; cloth particle tracking removed; positive assertions and runtime test added.
Two test failures fixed: assertIn on missing string and --test-timeout unrecognized argument.
Quaternion linear interpolation in _target_at_time produces non-unit quaternions at transitions.
Both uipc_cloth_franka tests green: static assertion + runtime CUDA integration.
assertIn('configure_contact_tabular') failed because API was not present in example and may not exist yet.
configure_contact_tabular added to example_uipc_cloth_franka.py for selective robot contact.
Ruff reported SyntaxError at line 1:0; example file started with blank line and may have been corrupted.
Final complete git diff confirmed: configure_contact_tabular plus all refactor changes in example.
Ruff E999 syntax error was transient; py_compile confirmed file syntactically valid.
Black disagrees with ruff formatting on both files; Python version mismatch warning.
Project ruff vs latest uvx ruff disagree: 2 import-sort errors in committed files.
Refactor example_uipc_cloth_franka.py: replace soft-constraint cloth manipulation with physical robot contact; fix uvx ruff I001 import-sort violations.
libuipc: explored clamp_close_activation_val and contact activation code.
UIPC/libuipc lacks .omx/wiki; sphere-driving code search initiated.
Robot Component should use free_joint for movement.
OMX Explore shell execution blocked by bwrap sandbox in Newton repo.
OMX Explore shell backend blocked by bwrap sandbox in Newton-Isaac/newton.
Studied Adjustable Constrained Soft-Tissue Dynamics (Wang, Zheng, Barbic 2020).
Paper archived to ~/claude-papers study library.
claude-papers library structure confirmed at ~/claude-papers/.
meta.json created for Wang-Zheng-Barbic 2020 in claude-papers library.
README.md study guide written for Wang-Zheng-Barbic 2020.
summary.md created for Wang-Zheng-Barbic 2020 study materials.
